_meta.description: Minimum-SQL-Server-version and deprecated-construct data for a subset of this grammar's node kinds, keyed by the kind name in test/node-kinds.txt. Anything not listed is either accepted starting from the grammar's documented floor (SQL Server 2008, see README's 'SQL Server versions' section) or is not yet classified here.
limitations: Several node kinds are shared by more than one construct with different minimum versions (e.g. 'trim' covers both the plain SQL Server 2017 TRIM(string) form and the SQL Server 2022 TRIM(chars FROM string) form; 'returning_clause' covers both JSON_OBJECT/JSON_ARRAY's 2022 RETURNING and JSON_VALUE/JSON_QUERY's 2025 RETURNING/WITH ARRAY WRAPPER). Where this happens, minVersion is the earliest attested use and a note names the later-only forms.

Not every version-specific or deprecated construct has its own node kind (e.g. the VECTOR data type and numbered-procedure ';N' suffix are fields/tokens on an existing rule, not distinct kinds), so this file cannot represent them at node-kind granularity yet.

test/check-registries.mjs checks that every node kind named here exists in test/node-kinds.txt and that every corpusCase names a test/corpus file and a case title that exist. It does not check that every version-specific kind is classified here, so a kind missing from this file is not a claim that it has been reviewed.

json_object.corpusCase: test/corpus/json.txt — "JSON_OBJECT and JSON_ARRAY constructors with NULL handling and RETURNING (2022)"

json_array.corpusCase: test/corpus/json.txt — "JSON_OBJECT and JSON_ARRAY constructors with NULL handling and RETURNING (2022)"

ai_generate_embeddings.corpusCase: test/corpus/expressions.txt — "AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS with USE MODEL and PARAMETERS (2025)"

trim.note: Only the FROM/LEADING/TRAILING/BOTH form needs 2022; the plain TRIM(string) form is available since SQL Server 2017. This node kind covers both, so treat 2022 as the conservative floor when a downstream rule cannot see the argument shape.
trim.corpusCase: test/corpus/expressions.txt — "TRIM with a FROM argument and LEADING, TRAILING, BOTH (2022)"

returning_clause.note: JSON_OBJECT/JSON_ARRAY's RETURNING needs 2022; JSON_VALUE's RETURNING and JSON_QUERY's WITH ARRAY WRAPPER need 2025. This node kind cannot distinguish the two contexts, so treat 2022 as the floor and 2025 as the safe target when the parent invocation is JSON_VALUE or JSON_QUERY.
returning_clause.corpusCase: test/corpus/json.txt — "JSON_OBJECT and JSON_ARRAY constructors with NULL handling and RETURNING (2022)" and "JSON_VALUE RETURNING and JSON_QUERY WITH ARRAY WRAPPER (2025)"

distinct_from.corpusCase: test/corpus/expressions.txt — "IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM"

not_distinct_from.corpusCase: test/corpus/expressions.txt — "IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM"

readtext_statement.reason: READTEXT is deprecated in favor of .WRITE/OPENROWSET(BULK) large-value access; still executes.
readtext_statement.corpusCase: test/corpus/misc_ddl.txt — "The deprecated text-pointer statements READTEXT, WRITETEXT and UPDATETEXT"

writetext_statement.reason: WRITETEXT is deprecated in favor of the same replacement as READTEXT; still executes.
writetext_statement.corpusCase: test/corpus/misc_ddl.txt — "The deprecated text-pointer statements READTEXT, WRITETEXT and UPDATETEXT"

setuser_statement.reason: SETUSER is deprecated in favor of EXECUTE AS; still executes.

table_hint.reason: The bare table-hint form (FROM t (NOLOCK), with no WITH keyword) is deprecated in favor of FROM t WITH (NOLOCK); still executes.
table_hint.note: This node kind also represents the current WITH (...) form. This entry applies only when the table_hint node has no keyword_with child.
